item.text:
Reconstructed all 17 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman verses in `romanLyrics`. Punjabi grammar throughout the poem supports updating the Urdu label to `Panjabi` (`pa-Arab`). Both versions align across a two-line opening and five three-line stanzas.

I treated “Ch Faiyaz Party Sialkot” as a reciter credit and read “veran” in the lap verse as `ویرن`, a form of address for a brother. Only the selected lyric was edited.
